v12-5.candidate: And the men of Gilead seized beforehand the crossings of the Jordan belonging to Ephraim. And when the escaped ones of Ephraim said, “Let us cross,” the men of Gilead asked them, “Are you of Ephraim?” And they said, “We are not.”

v12-6.candidate: They said to them, “Please say ‘Password.’” They could not manage to speak in that way. They seized them and slaughtered them at the Jordan’s crossings. Forty-two thousand of Ephraim fell at that time.
